sections.title: Brave Frontier Heroes
sections.content: A caring spirit from the illustrated book "The Ocean Princess" written by the Fabula brothers. According to the story, Amune was the princess of a palace found at the bottom of the sea. Since everyone who came to visit her would always forget about her when they returned home, she devised a spell to seal her visitors away for fear of going unremembered. One of the people she sealed away was a talented illustrator whose town began plunging into chaos after its inhabitants became unable to recognize reality from fiction. Such was the ruckus that the town itself began falling apart.
